Remark
1. 3.2.9\group maximum-principle Source: topping:page-0048 Scalar curvature is only one curvature quantity whose positivity is preserved under Ricci flow on closed manifolds. Other preserved conditions include positive curvature operator in any dimension, positive isotropic curvature in four dimensions, and positive Ricci curvature in dimension three or less. Negative curvatures are not preserved in general.
